.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; max-width:1920px; margin:0 auto; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:'Pretendard JP', 'Noto Sans Regular';}
.evWrap button {margin:0; padding:0; border:0; background:none; font:inherit; cursor:pointer;}

._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav a {position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:auto; height:100%; padding:0 32px; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);}

._evt_content_1 ._bg_layer {position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0;}

._beauty_tab ._tab {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:41px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:100px; background:#6D0C0C; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.36px; color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6); white-space:nowrap; transition:background 0.3s, color 0.3s;}
._beauty_slider ._card {flex:0 0 auto; width:272px; margin:0 16px; border-radius:14.4px; overflow:hidden; background:#fff; transition:width 0.5s ease, border-radius 0.5s ease;}

._beauty_slider ._card ._info {display:block; padding:14.3158px 17.3835px 16.3609px 17.3835px; background:#fff; color:#323232; text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Hiragino Sans', Meiryo, sans-serif; word-break:break-word; transition:padding 0.5s ease;}
._beauty_slider ._card ._brand {display:block; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0; line-height:20.4511px; transition:font-size 0.5s ease, line-height 0.5s ease;}

._beauty_slider ._card ._cond {display:block; margin-top:4.8px; font-size:14.4px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-0.432px; line-height:19.2px; transition:font-size 0.5s ease, line-height 0.5s ease, margin 0.5s ease;}
